# GanttPRO

> > GanttPRO is a project management platform offering REST API documentation and developer tools for building custom integrations with their Gantt chart and project planning software.

GanttPRO provides comprehensive API documentation for developers looking to integrate project management capabilities into their applications. The platform supports multiple programming languages including JavaScript, Python, and Ruby, with JSON-based REST API endpoints for authentication and project management operations.

## Key Topics

- GanttPRO API
- REST API
- Project Management Integration
- API Authentication
- JSON
- HTTP Methods
- JavaScript SDK
- Python SDK
- Ruby SDK
- Developer Portal
- API Reference
- Custom Integrations
- Gantt Charts
- API Documentation

## API Reference

- [GanttPRO Developer API Documentation Portal](https://developer.ganttpro.com/): Complete REST API documentation portal for building custom integrations with GanttPRO, including authentication, endpoints, and code examples in JavaScript, Python, and Ruby
